Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2021-28799 hard-coded credentials vulnerability to access QNAP NAS devices running out-of-date HBS 3 versions
Replaces victims' files with password-protected 7-zip archives
Extorts victims by demanding ransom payments in bitcoins to obtain file passwords
Impacted Systems: QNAP NAS devices running certain versions of HBS 3 (Hybrid Backup Sync)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2021-28799 hard-coded credentials vulnerability in HBS 3
